item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q019_stable_periodic_release_semantics","answer":"The current-release endpoint reports SCOPe 2.08, labeled 2.08-stable, released September 22, 2021, and latest periodic update 2.08-2026-08-16, dated August 16, 2026. For reproducibility, cite the exact dataset used: 2.08-stable for the stable snapshot, or 2.08-2026-08-16 for that periodic snapshot; citing only “current” or “latest” is insufficient. The periodic label denotes a dated incremental update within the 2.08 release series, incorporating ongoing classification additions, rather than a new stable release or a wholesale revision of the evolutionary hierarchy. Its date does not imply that every classification was newly curated or experimentally validated.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/2.08"]}]}
